description: This file defines a Todo class and a Todos container class for managing a todo list, including filtering, adding, updating, toggling, and deleting todos. It also includes a nanoid function for generating unique IDs.

classes.name: Todos
classes.description: A mutable, observable container for a todo list that supports filtering, event firing, and list manipulation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new todo with specified text, generating a unique ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a todo by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a todo's properties based on provided edits.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a todo by ID.

methods.name: toggleAll
methods.description: Toggles all todos' completion status based on current state.

methods.name: clearCompleted
methods.description: Removes all completed todos from the list.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Adds hashchange event listener to update filter.

methods.name: filtered
methods.description: Returns the list of todos filtered according to current filter.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Getter and setter for current filter state.
